title: Flatside Wilderness Enhancement Act
official_summary:
Flatside Wilderness Enhancement Act

(Sec. 2) The bill adds certain land in the Ouachita National Forest, comprising approximately 640 acres and identified as Recommended Wilderness Additions, to the Flatside Wilderness in the portion of the forest in Arkansas.

(Sec. 3) The bill designates the wilderness additions as the Bethune Woods-Flatside Wilderness.

summary.headline: A 2019 law adds about 640 acres of Arkansas national forest land to the Flatside Wilderness and names the new area the Bethune Woods-Flatside Wilderness.
summary.what_it_does: The law adds roughly 640 acres in the Ouachita National Forest in Arkansas to the existing Flatside Wilderness. Those acres were previously identified as recommended wilderness additions. The law also names the added land the Bethune Woods-Flatside Wilderness. The summary does not list specific rules for visitors or land managers.

who_it_affects.group: Hikers, campers, and other outdoor visitors to the Ouachita National Forest in Arkansas
who_it_affects.how: The added land becomes part of a designated wilderness area, so it will be managed under federal wilderness rules.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. Forest Service managers of the Ouachita National Forest
who_it_affects.how: They must manage the roughly 640 added acres as part of the Flatside Wilderness under the new designation.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 10, 2019.
